itemId.description: Unique identifier for the item from gameItems.json

itemType.description: Type category of the item (consumable, tool, equipment, etc.)

maxStack.description: Maximum stack size for this item

metadata.description: Additional item-specific data (stats, attributes, enchantments, etc.)

quantity.description: Number of items in the stack

itemValue.description: Base value of the item in game currency

stackable.description: Whether this item can be stacked with others of the same type

lastModified.description: When the record was last modified

logRecordUri.description: URI of the game.log record that documents the acquisition of this item

main.description: Beta version: Record representing an item in a player's game inventory

questId.description: ID of the quest that rewarded this item

gameCardUri.description: URI of the game card that provided this item

rewardStreak.description: Daily reward streak when item was acquired

sourceDetails.description: Additional details about how the item was acquired
